Elena: Quick draft for the v2.14 internal announce. Change window 16:00-17:00 PT. Need blast owner + canary lead. Short bullets below.

Elena: ```
v2.14 highlights:
- smarter batching heuristics to reduce tail latency
- per-route model pinning API
- fix: KV cache leak affecting streaming sessions
- ops: tighter deploy health checks
```

Elena: Rollback ideas: sustained 5xx > 1.5% for 5m OR p99 latency > 900ms for 10m OR token-cost +20% for 15m. Thoughts?

Tom: I'll own the internal blast. Minor nit: replace "smarter batching" with "batching heuristics". Rollback thresholds sound reasonable, maybe tighten p99 to 850ms?

Priya: Happy to own canary watch. Plan: 5m smoke, 20m stability, then 10% traffic. If anything off I call rollback.

Tom: OK tighten p99 to 850ms. Final blast copy I'll post at T+30m after canary green.

Elena: final small ask: ask folks to paste bad samples in this thread + #support so we can triage output-quality regressions.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary -> staging | version=v2.14 | scheduled=16:00 PT | cmd=`/deploy target=canary version=v2.14 wait=15m`

Priya: First 8m: no 5xx spikes, p99 ~430ms, token-cost steady. Continuing watch.

Tom: I'll hold off blast until 16:30 PT (first 30m green). Final copy will be posted and pinned then.

deploy-bot: Canary health nominal at 16:22 PT. No error increase detected.

Elena: great work. Using this thread as single source-of-truth for the window. I'll file the release-note summary (with links to canary logs and rollback playbook) after the window.
